# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Middle-aged to older
- **Gender:** Female
- **Role:** Mistress of Green Gables and household manager  <sub>[v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Cuthbert  <sub>[v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014)</sub>; Miss Marilla Cuthbert  <sub>[v1 c19 P90](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0090)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin, gaunt woman with dark hair showing streaks of gray. She has sharp angles and a stern, unyielding expression, though her face is occasionally softened by a rusty smile. Her hair is kept pinned up tightly in a neat knot.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P12](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0012), [v1 c3 P22](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0022)_

## Personality

Marilla is a practical, pragmatic, and sensible woman governed by strict moral principles and duty. She maintains a reserved, stern exterior, often frowning at foolishness or emotional outbursts, yet she possesses a quiet sense of humor and a deep, underlying kindness. She values order, cleanliness, and hard work in her home. Though cautious and slow to show affectionate feelings, she softens toward those under her care and feels deep loyalty and quiet maternal devotion.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020), [v1 c6 P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 c6 P26](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0026)_

## Traits

- Practical and pragmatic  <sub>[v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020)</sub>
- Strict and disciplined  <sub>[v1 c6 P27](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0027)</sub>
- Possesses a quiet sense of humor  <sub>[v1 c3 P12](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0012), [v1 c6 P26](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0026)</sub>
- Frugal and orderly

## Abilities

- Household management and cooking  <sub>[v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000)</sub>
- Milking cows and handling farmstead tasks  <sub>[v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029)</sub>

## Goals

- To raise Anne into a good, proper, and sensible woman  <sub>[v1 c6 P18](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0018), [v1 c19 P90](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0090)</sub>
- To maintain and preserve Green Gables

## History

Marilla Cuthbert resided at Green Gables with her unmarried brother Matthew, living a quiet and orderly life. Wanting help on the farm, they sent word to adopt an orphan boy, but due to a misunderstanding, Anne Shirley was sent instead. Although Marilla initially intended to return the young girl, she took pity on Anne after seeing Mrs. Blewett's severe nature and agreed to keep her. Over time, Marilla raised Anne with firm discipline and practical instruction, gradually growing deeply attached to her despite Anne's vivid imagination and frequent misadventures. Following Matthew's sudden death, Marilla faced the loss of her brother and threats to her sight from failing health. To prevent Marilla from having to sell Green Gables, Anne gave up her university scholarship to stay home, cementing their lifelong maternal bond.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 c3 P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), [v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014), [v1 c6 P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 c6 P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020)_

## Background by volume

- Has lived at Green Gables for sixty years alongside her brother Matthew
- Shared a youth with John Blythe, ending in an unresolved quarrel
